name: Park Jae-Hyun
bio:
Jae-Hyun's passion for motorsport ignited during his university days, fueled by late-night viewings of Formula 1 races. After graduating with a degree in mechanical engineering from KAIST, he immediately pursued a career in racing, starting as a data analyst for a smaller Korean racing team. His meticulous approach and knack for identifying performance gains quickly propelled him into the role of a junior race engineer. 

He honed his skills for several years before being scouted by ART Grand Prix Academy, where he now works with promising young drivers. Jae-Hyun believes in a collaborative engineering style, prioritizing clear communication and data-driven decision-making. He's known for his ability to quickly adapt to changing track conditions and driver feedback, making him a valuable asset in the pit lane.

Jae-Hyun distinguishes himself through his calm demeanor under pressure and a relentless focus on the details. He can often be found poring over telemetry data late into the night, searching for that extra tenth of a second.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly parted to the side with a slight wave.
physical.description: Jae-Hyun has a focused look, with sharp eyes and a thoughtful expression.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with hand-drawn diagrams and calculations.
Has a habit of tapping his pen against his teeth when deep in thought.
Insists on drinking green tea before every race session.
